title: Design: New Customer without AP/AR access has no credit fields
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role can create customers but does not have View and Manage AP/AR Data.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p5-05-new-customer-without-view-and-manage-ap-ar-data.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window has no Credit Terms and no Credit Limit.
  • The Sales Representative field follows State/Province and Country directly, with no gap left (as in ct-p5-05-new-customer-without-view-and-manage-ap-ar-data.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N1: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, New Customer and Edit Customer show neither Credit Terms nor Credit Limit (as Edit Customer today).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
